title: 雨の日のカフェ
description: 雨音の似合う無人のカフェを、窓光と木の質感で静かにまとめた素材です。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 雨天の柔らかな窓光と小さな暖色ランプ
tone.colorTemp: 4800K。青灰色と木の暖色を自然に混ぜる
tone.framing: 35mm・目線高・16:9。窓、卓上、奥行きを穏やかに配置
tone.texture: 雨粒ガラス、古い木、陶器、布、薄い湯気

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: an empty neighborhood cafe on a rainy afternoon, wooden tables beside tall rain-streaked windows
Scene/backdrop: modest unbranded cafe between busy hours, completely unoccupied
Subject: tables, chairs, wet windows, plain lamps, and softly blurred street, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial interior photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, eye-level, 35mm lens, medium-wide view with calm layered depth
Lighting/mood: soft rainy window light mixed with small warm lamps, 4800K balance, intimate reflective mood
Color palette: blue gray, dark honey wood, warm cream, muted amber
Materials/textures: raindrop glass, worn wood, matte ceramic, woven fabric, thin steam
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable menu text, no logos, no brands, no watermark
